description: Generated code against PostgreSQL through pgx, with the same contracts as database/sql: a JSON column overridden to a plain struct and to []string round-trips; an optional enum-array parameter binds NULL when nil and its values otherwise; a batch upsert repeating a key succeeds; an array column inside sgl.embed reads; and SELECT * and RETURNING * name their columns, so the methods keep working after a migration adds a column to every table, including with cached prepared statements.
